sentence_stem: Although my brother is only six years old,
full_sentence: Although my brother is only six years old, he can swim very well.
acceptable_variants: he can already ride a bike.
he is able to swim very well.

options.text: he can to swim very well.
options.why_wrong: After 'can', we use the base verb without 'to', so 'can swim' is correct.
The modal verb 'can' never adds an -s, even with 'he' or 'she'.
After 'can', we use the base verb, not the -ing form.

grammar_focus: Can for ability, with 'although' showing contrast
explanation: After 'although', the clause shows a contrast with the young age. The modal verb 'can' is followed by the base form of the verb.
translation: Хоча мій брат має лише шість років, він дуже добре плаває.
